response.sql: WITH group_rates AS (SELECT site.riskeval, 1.0 * SUM(scan.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(scan.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans AS scan INNER JOIN sites AS site ON site.zoneregistry = scan.zoneref GROUP BY site.riskeval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM group_rates) SELECT AVG(group_rates.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(group_rates.rate - benchmark.rate) AS average_excess FROM group_rates CROSS JOIN benchmark WHERE group_rates.rate > benchmark.rate;

assumptions.assumption: A group with zero total duration has an undefined rate and is excluded from the benchmark and final averages. SUM ignores NULL measurements.
